# Space Mesmerise

> > Space Mesmerise offers unique space-inspired home decor and gifts, featuring crystal lamps, astronaut sculptures, and cosmic accessories with a 4.9 Etsy rating.

Founded in 2022 in Sydney, Space Mesmerise specializes in eco-friendly space-themed products including The Original Crystal Space Lamp, Planet Armillary Sphere Sculptures, and Astronaut Bookends. The site also features educational content about planetary science, space technology, and astronomy.

## Planetary Science & Astronomy

- [Uncovering the Mysteries of Mercury's Interior: Composition and Struct](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/planets/uncovering-the-mysteries-of-mercurys-interior-composition-and-structure): Mercury's three-layer structure: crust, mantle, and iron-rich core
- [Uncovering the Secrets of Mercury's Surface: A Deep Dive into its Mine](https://spacemesmerise.com/blogs/planets/uncovering-the-secrets-of-mercurys-surface-a-deep-dive-into-its-minerals-and-elements): Mercury surface composition: silicon, iron, sulfur, and plagioclase
- [Mercury - The Enigmatic World: An Introduction to the Closest Planet t](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/planets/mercury-the-enigmatic-world-an-introduction-to-the-closest-planet-to-the-sun): Mercury basics: 88-day orbit, discovery history, Einstein's relativity
- [Unlocking the secrets: A Comprehensive Guide to Understanding What Mar](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-gb/blogs/planets/unlocking-the-secrets-a-comprehensive-guide-to-understanding-what-mars-is-made-of): Mars composition: layered structure, geological history, and formation
- [Unveiling the Mystery of Mercury: Its Significance in Ancient Cultures](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/planets/unveiling-the-mystery-of-mercury-its-significance-in-ancient-cultures-and-mythology): Mercury in mythology: Roman messenger god Hermes across ancient cultures
- [The Fascinating History of Mercury Observation and Discovery: From Myt](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/planets/the-fascinating-history-of-mercury-observation-and-discovery-from-mythological-roots-to-modern-discoveries): Mercury observation history: Babylonians to NASA's Messenger spacecraft
- [Understanding the Significance of Mercury: Interactions with Planets a](https://spacemesmerise.com/blogs/planets/understanding-the-significance-of-mercury-interactions-with-planets-and-bodies-in-the-solar-system): Mercury's role in solar system: orbital mechanics and planet interactions
- [The Elusive Search for Signs of Life on Mercury: A 3000-word Explorati](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/planets/the-elusive-search-for-signs-of-life-on-mercury-a-3000-word-exploration): Exploring Mercury for microbial life via MESSENGER and BepiColombo

## Space Technology & Exploration

- [Unlocking the Secrets of Rockets: A Comprehensive Guide to Understandi](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-nz/blogs/space-technology/unlocking-the-secrets-of-rockets-a-comprehensive-guide-to-understanding-the-different-parts-of-a-rocket): Rocket anatomy: engines, fuel tanks, guidance systems, and propulsion
- [Exploring the Fascinating World of Rocket Nozzles: The Ultimate Guide](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-nz/blogs/space-technology/exploring-the-fascinating-world-of-rocket-nozzles-the-ultimate-guide-for-space-enthusiasts): Rocket nozzle types: convergent, conical, bell, and De Laval designs

- [Understanding the Different Types of Space Station Life Support System](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/space-technology/understanding-the-different-types-of-space-station-life-support-systems): Space station life support: ECLSS, ACLS systems from Mercury to ISS
- [Unlocking the Secrets of Our Solar System: A Comprehensive Guide to NA](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-gb/blogs/space-exploration/unlocking-the-secrets-of-our-solar-system-a-comprehensive-guide-to-nasas-new-horizons-program): NASA New Horizons mission: Pluto flyby and Kuiper Belt exploration

## Astronomy & Observation

- [Exploring the Stars: A Guide to Different Telescope Mounts for Astrono](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/space-technology/exploring-the-stars-a-guide-to-different-telescope-mounts-for-astronomy-enthusiasts): Telescope mounts guide: Altazimuth, Equatorial, Dobsonian, and Fork types
- [Unraveling The Mystery: The Different Types of Telescope Mirrors](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/space-technology/unraveling-the-mystery-the-different-types-of-telescope-mirrors): Telescope mirror types: Cassegrain, Ritchey-Chrétien, and convex designs
- [Unlocking the Secrets of the Universe through the Use of Telescopes in](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/space-technology/unlocking-the-secrets-of-the-universe-through-the-use-of-telescopes-in-gravitational-wave-detection): Gravitational wave detection: LIGO telescopes and Einstein's relativity
- [Exploring The Andromeda Galaxy: The Ultimate Guide](https://spacemesmerise.com/en-us/blogs/astronomy/exploring-the-andromeda-galaxy-the-ultimate-guide): Andromeda Galaxy M31: closest spiral galaxy 2.5M light-years from Earth
- [Unlocking the Secrets of the Cosmos: How We Measure the Distance to St](https://spacemesmerise.com/blogs/astronomy/unlocking-the-secrets-of-the-cosmos-how-we-measure-the-distance-to-stars): Stellar distance measurement: parallax method and Gaia spacecraft mapping
